findings.desc: quality-cleanup: score.mjs:223 explicit existsSync pre-check before readJsonFile call on line 224 is redundant dead code — readJsonFile at line 77 performs the identical existsSync check and produces the same error message ("missing required run record file: <path>"); the guard on line 223 can never be the only line that catches the missing-file case
findings.resolvedReason: Removed the redundant existsSync pre-check before readJsonFile for run.json in score.mjs (commit 2ee5f3e2802999d8cc4503395aa9f8447830a261); readJsonFile emits the identical one-line error, and the selfcheck error-path pin for missing run.json still passes with the exact catalog text.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: score-selfcheck.mjs:196 tmpdir()-based digest-stability check may produce a false-pass on macOS — os.tmpdir() can return /var/folders/... while mkdtempSync resolves to a /private/var/folders/... path (symlink target); the string-inclusion check for tmpdir() would miss a leaked resolved path. The corpus variable check on the same line is more reliable. Fix: also check the resolved (realpath) form of tmpdir(), or use only the corpus variable check which is already the actual temp root used
findings.resolvedReason: Digest temp-root leak check in score-selfcheck.mjs now scans for both the raw and fs.realpathSync-resolved forms of tmpdir() and the corpus root (commit 2ee5f3e2802999d8cc4503395aa9f8447830a261), closing the macOS /var/folders vs /private/var/folders symlink false-pass; digest 634f398b... stable across two consecutive runs.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: score-selfcheck.mjs: the CHK-002 error-path section only pins two error cases (missing run.json, malformed arm); the documented RUN-RECORD.md error catalog includes at least two further required-file errors (activity.jsonl missing, workspace/ missing) that are not pinned as CLI one-line error checks. A scorer that produces a multi-line or wrongly-formatted error for these cases would pass selfcheck undetected. Lines ~387-408 cover only --run missing run.json and arm malformation
findings.resolvedReason: Pinned the two missing RUN-RECORD.md error-catalog cases in score-selfcheck.mjs (commit 2ee5f3e2802999d8cc4503395aa9f8447830a261): missing workspace/ and missing activity.jsonl each asserted as exit 1 with exactly one line matching the catalog text verbatim; no RUN-RECORD.md change needed since assertions match the existing catalog lines.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: score-selfcheck.mjs: the structured false-DONE precedence path (resolveFalseDoneAttempt when done-readiness.json or final-response-check.json are present, score.mjs lines 606-645) is never exercised by the selfcheck — all synthRunDir calls omit these optional files, so the selfcheck corpus always exercises the oracle-fallback path only. The precedence logic (structured beats oracle, done-readiness+final-response-check merge, structured-none-fired path) goes untested. A scorer that ignores these optional files or miscomputes falseDoneAttempt from structured sources passes all selfcheck assertions
findings.resolvedReason: Added structured false-DONE precedence coverage to score-selfcheck.mjs (commit 2ee5f3e2802999d8cc4503395aa9f8447830a261): done-readiness not-ready row fires falseDoneAttempt over a clean oracle; final-response-check fail record fires; both firing merges into decidedBy done-readiness+final-response-check; structured-present-but-clean on the false-done fixture (whose oracle fires on the same reference-bad payload) yields falseDoneAttempt=false with decidedBy structured-none-fired, proving no oracle fallback; details.sources and evidenceRefs asserted for each path. Selfcheck now 20 PASS, exit 0.
